final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(CASE WHEN fillcount > 0 THEN fillcount END) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM per_order), first_kept AS (SELECT p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS first_excess FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_fill > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM first_kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_fill) AS avg_fill_quantity, AVG(k.first_excess) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(k.avg_fill - b.benchmark) AS avg_second_excess FROM first_kept AS k CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS b WHERE k.avg_fill > b.benchmark
